_comment: CityU School of Energy & Environment POSITIONAL elective weightings, read visually 2026-07-12 from 2026_JUPAS_AdmissionScoreFormulaAndScores.pdf p6-7 (the 2025 PDF and the VLM 2025 transcription show the same scheme and values, so both years get the same model — this also keeps year_changes quiet). Official cells: 'x2.5 Biology/Chemistry/Physics in 1st Elective', 'x1.5 Biology/Chemistry/Geography/M1/M2/Physics in 2nd Elective', 'x1 other elective subjects'; JS1053 adds 'x2.5 Economics/BAFS in 2nd Elective'. The scrape and VLM flattened the positional qualifiers into per-subject weights, wrongly weighting a 3rd+ elective (user-reported, JS1050). Encoding: ordered best_of pools; pools CONSUME their picks (calculator pool-claiming), and pools sharing a `slot` tag compete for ONE elective position — JS1053's 2nd elective is x2.5 for Econ/BAFS OR x1.5 for the science list, never both. Note the engine picks slot fillers to the student's benefit (pool order = weight order), where CityU's own calculator may assign positions strictly by score rank; the divergence is a small benefit-of-doubt corner (e.g. Econ L3 preferred x2.5 over a 5** Physics x1.5 for the 2nd slot).
